verdicts.originalText: The Inspiration Field only heals the active character while their HP is at or below 70%; above that they receive Bennett's ATK bonus instead. The planner shows the heal on every field tick regardless of the character's current HP.
verdicts.proposedText: The heal is shown on every field tick, but only characters at or below 70% HP are healed — above that they get the ATK buff instead.
verdicts.rationale: The heal is gated by recipientHpBelow, an optimistic-by-design condition (renders assumed-true plus caveat since HP cannot be simulated), so the caveat is a legitimate divergence note that must stay rewrite, never implementDelete. Compressed to the style guide's canonical form for this exact worked example: dropped the character name (Bennett), the ability/summon names (Inspiration Field, ATK bonus source), and the banned token 'planner' while preserving the 70% heal gate, the ATK-buff swap above 70%, and the every-tick divergence. Under target length and one sentence.

claimsLost.claim: the heal only reaches the active character (effect target 'active'), not the whole party
